objective: Decide whether the non-discoverable agentkit candidate has sufficient behavior, E2E, recovery and maturity evidence for promotion after donor stability cycle 2.
baseline: agentkit candidate 0.1.0 plus direct invocation of the ten donor skills

environment.runtime: python-3 deterministic fixtures and current user-authorized semantic workflows

criteria.structure: official validator passes and all resources resolve
criteria.routing: explicit agentkit requests route while direct specialist, team and Agentic OS requests do not
criteria.behavior: three real workflows produce verified artifacts through exact locked donors
criteria.scripts-tools: synthetic/real separation, false completion, contract hashes and rollback plan pass
criteria.security-authority: donors remain unchanged and lifecycle effects require separate authority
criteria.coexistence: candidate remains outside discovery until promotion
criteria.lifecycle: two stable donor cycles and frozen upgrade, rollback and holdout contracts exist
criteria.user-outcome: the current request obtains a promotable stable composite without false host-activation claims

holdout_policy.rule: The suite is outside the distributed pack and is rotated if exposure changes candidate behavior.

execution_policy.side_effects: repository-local candidate, evaluation and generated staging only
